reviews.text: They're very helpful and they respect the loss you had.
Thank you for choosing us to care for your pet! It’s a privilege to be part of their journey, and we’re so grateful for your trust and positive review.

This was my first visit to BluePearl for diagnostic testing was a positive experience. My cat, Chloe, needed an echocardiogram. Eugene, the Nursing Supervisor at the front desk, greeted me, confirmed the appointment, offered a bottle of water and kept me updated during the 10-minute wait.

The technician then greeted me and took the time to explain the echocardiogram process and what to expect. While I waited to meet with the cardiologist, I also had the opportunity to observe Tijana at the reception desk interacting with clients and answering phone calls. She was very knowledgeable, patient, and welcoming with everyone she assisted.

From the moment I arrived, I felt Chloe was in caring, capable hands. This was my first time bringing her to BluePearl for diagnostic testing, and based on my experience, I would highly recommend them.
Horrible pet hospital never come here
DO NOT COME HERE!!! They killed a cat by giving it 5x the lethal dose of a medication and are DELETING reviews to cover it up. If you delete this I will come right back btw.
Literally such rude staff, horrible care to my pet. Didn’t solve a single damn issue nor did they answer any of my questions. Never bringing my business here again.

I’m incredibly grateful for Josh and the help he gave me during a really scary situation with my cat.. I called in the middle of the night after my cat had swallowed a long piece of plastic and I was panicking and had no idea what my next step should be. Josh was so kind, patient, calm nd helpful. He took the situation seriously without making me panic even more and helped guide me through what I needed to do next

Even though I ultimately had to take my cat elsewhere for further care- I genuinely would have felt lost without his help. Thankfully, everything ended up working out and my cat is okay. I’m extremely grateful for the compassion and reassurance Josh showed me when I really needed it. Thank you so much!

The staff are compassionate and patient. I brought my 16-year-old Silver Tabby who was having trouble breathing and also had a bloody nose. Dr. Jason Simmons answered my questions and preformed comprehensive testing. She doesn't have Pneumonia, what a relief! The antibiotics are starting to work -- Sabrina is on the road to recovery!

I was fortunate that it was not busy so my dog was seen almost immediately. Dr. Mendoza explained very clearly what needed to be done and I my dog is doing well. He was kept overnight but I was confident my doggy was in good hands. The staff is fantastic!
It’s an honor to care for your pet! Our team is dedicated to providing the best possible care, and knowing we’ve earned your trust means everything. We truly appreciate your support!
Took great care of my dog. Will recommend to anyone in need

this place killed my cat. they should be banned from treating any type of animal ever again. they gave me false hope and told me that i caught my cats crystals super early and that i was lucky. they completely UNDERTREATED HIM AND MISREAD THE SITUATION. THEY TOLD ME HIS SYMPTOMS WERE NORMAL AND TO JUST GIVE HIM MEDICATION. HE DIED THE NEXT DAY. DO NOT TAKE YOUR CAT HERE.
Charged unnecessary fees for services that was not needed. Had to deal with micro aggression

stay far away  you will pay for a consultation to only get a price list/ proposal of ridiculously priced procedures. a consultation should provide a written summary of what was seen and honest idea of prognosis.  almost criminal

Waited from 2 am till 630am yesterday to get my cat seen. Poor guy wasn’t eating or drinking, lethargic and vomited multiple times. The vet on site deemed him as non urgent so we just waited forever in a freezing cold waiting room with no updates on when he could be seen. After meeting the overnight doc, he gave our little guy some anti nausea meds and told us we could do some bloodwork testing to figure out what’s wrong but didn’t push for it since he kept mentioning our pet seemed stable in the last 4 hrs that we waited. Vet didn’t explain why the testing would be highly recommended. The appointment seemed rushed and I didn’t understand clearly what I’d do with my pet if he continued to feel unwell. No aftercare notes were left so reception had no idea when we called back later in the day what to do with our cat. They just told us we needed to come back and that the doc we saw had already left for the day so no idea what to do.

I didn’t walk away with an appetite stimulant that our poor guy really needed as he did not try to eat even 6 hrs after returning for the doc visit. We had to take our cat to another urgent care - union pets which Dr Lara re accessed his condition, gave us meds to take home and right after getting home he was already feeling better.

Overall the wait time if your pet is not straight up dying when he she gets there is ridiculous long for unknown reason. The doctor was not thorough in the explanations for care and testing and the prices I was quoted was at least double what the other urgent care was proposing. Overall felt like I wasted a huge amount of time and money and it didn’t cure the conditions that my pet was suffering through.
Your trust means so much to us! Caring for your pet brings us so much joy, and we’re truly grateful to be a part of their health and happiness. Thank you for your support!
Caring staff, attentive to our dog’s needs. Dr. Mendoza explained everything very clearly and we were put at ease.
Great service and treat my pet with the proper care. I recommend it .
We went here twice with our cat and they were phenomenal. Talked straight and did not push for any tests and in fact recommended local regular vets for the non emergency stuff. Very caring as well.

I loved that it wasn't a frantic owner/pet circus at the front desk and lobby. The staff was all excellent, our nurse and doctor inspired confidence in their care. I enthusiastically recommend the Dermatology department.

I was very satisfied with my recent experience at BluePearl Pet Hospital. The receptionist, staff and Dr. Wiley were all very nice and professional. The location was convenient and it's local, thus the commute was less stressful for my canine baby. The only complain that I have is it is a little pricier than some of the other pet hospitals but overall it's worth it.
Excellent
Here at 7am no answer at the door or on the phone
Doctors and staff are outstanding! Polite, accomodating, and efficient.

I want to say a big thank you to all the staff that helped my siblings and I this past Sunday. I brought my beloved cat Lucy in for respiratory distress and unfortunately was informed that she was fighting more than she could handle. Cancer sucks. I had to make a decision before my siblings arrived. Dr. Mendoza and staff were patient, kind, and made sure I understood what was happening before helping me to choose what to do. I made the tough call and everyone was behind me ensuring I was okay. It's still not fully sunk in but I am forever grateful for everyone at BluePearl clinic. Once again, thank you.
Very good service and excellent care of my dog.
If you care about your fur baby, DO NOT bring them here. Absolute horrible experience

I interacted with approximately five different staff members, each providing conflicting information about our pet’s condition and treatment. We were even given inconsistent answers and overall horrible experience. Unsafe, unprofessional and a threat to our communities pets
All doctors were very friendly n listened to you ; very understanding to you n your pet !

Wanted to share details of my experience.  Yes expensive , very BUT. So wonderful, so kind, experienced kind doctors , nurses  and staff helping us and our sweet pets.  I cant say enough about how wonderful my experience was with the forest hills blue pearl animal hospital!!

This is specific to Dr.seltzer, nurse Rachel, and the 2 amazing front desk associate.

My cat felt very cared for by the staff themselves, and I can see why Dr. Seltzer is a hot “commodity”. She is so knowledgeable and REALLY takes her time with patience and their hoomans. In addition, I received a really detailed write up of everything she told me within the same day!

Thank you for your review. We know how important your pet’s care is, and we always strive to provide the best experience. If there’s anything we could have done differently to better support you, we’d love to hear your thoughts.
The lady wasn't very nice. Tbh I already felt like a bad owner and felt bad enough as it was but when I asked questions she just made me feel stupid and worse :(

Yesterday i went to bluepearl to see if they can check my pet i waited 2 and half hours to be attended and they want to charge me $1,084 for non sense charge even the nurse couldn’t explain whats on the bill and the veterinarian I wasn’t happy went you checked my pet at all you didn’t checked him the appropriate way you just look his ears and that’s it you didn’t even use the appropriate tools very disappointed ☹️

Every staff member that we interacted with were so nice (reception, nurse, vet). I went during the Fourth of July weekend, so I'm very appreciative that they were available. The wait time was very fair considering the condition my cat was in and that it was a holiday. The bill was also very fair for an emergency facility. I didn't feel like they tried to pressure me in doing unnecessary tests. You also get a 2% discount for using debit or cash.

My cat had a stroke, and we were rushing here, gave a call to give them a heads up that we were coming, just to get turned away because "we are too short". What kind of emergency room says that?! In an ER, patients are triaged and treated by severity, if you took your parent to the ER, how would you feel if they turned you away because they were "short"???!!! Don't call call yourselves a hospital if this is your policy.

I would give zero stars if I could. We showed up to blue pearl because my dog was acting totally normal all day, but later that night she started acting weird. When we got there we were checked in and then entire place was empty. Even though there was no one else in the hospital, we waited 45 minutes before anyone saw us.
They brought her back and we waited another hour before anyone came back out to see us.

The vet was lazy and incompetent- he kept pushing for euthanasia.
We left and went to another animal hospital in plainview who was more thorough and recommended surgery for a tumor on her liver. (BP told us the tumor was on her spleen)
We are so lucky we didnt listen to the first vet and got a second opinion. Our dog is now here- back to running around and acting like a puppy.

I brought my senior dog Finnley here for ER care per my primary care veterinarian’s advice due to (among many issues!) major kidney issues she was having. I was greeted by a very kind receptionist and was met with empathetic staff.  I saw reviews complaining about the wait time and yes, I did wait a bit but nothing outrageous and I can see why one may have to wait as this is ER and I saw what appeared to me really urgent cases (a dog was being rushed on a stretcher/bed).  They were very honest about my dog’s prognosis (no cure, probably has about 3-6 months), treatment options and they were pragmatic, which I appreciated.  Went back to my primary care vet the next day for some outpatient care per Blue Pearl and I am happy to report that Finnley seems better and comfortable for the time being.  Thank you Blue Pearl for your patience while I was crying hysterically and educating on how to keep Finnley as comfortable as possible while she is still with us.

My cat, Hoya, had to be rushed to the emergency room due to breathing problems. From the moment we arrived, all of the staff were incredibly kind, compassionate, and efficient. They made a very stressful situation much easier for both me and my cat.

Hoya had fluid/pus in his chest that needed to be removed, and Dr. Stephanie L. performed the procedure. Thanks to her skill and care, the procedure went smoothly, and Hoya is now recovering comfortably and breathing much better. I am truly grateful to Dr. Stephanie L. and the entire team for taking such good care of him. Thank you so much for everything.

Thank you for your review. We truly care about every pet and family we see, and we always want to provide the best experience possible. If there’s anything we could have done differently, we’d love to hear your thoughts. Your feedback helps us grow and improve.
Actually cared for my pets emergency and was swift and EXTREMELY HELPFUL 👍 …

I took my baby Nova to this pet hospital and the staff was very caring and understanding.  Upon our arrival the two staff members at the front desk was very pleasant they explained everything that would take place with my Nova. The doctor was also very kind and compassionate as she was explaining everything to me about Nova. I appreciate all of them for their kindness and support. I would highly recommend anyone looking for an urgent care for their furry friend to go to BluePearl Pet hospital.

Came in may 16 for a big German shepherd attacking my dog DR.Breanna omg was amazing she's the sweetest most caring doctor I know her team took very good care of my dog I couldn't stop crying she cried with me ❤️ she saved my baby I'm forever grateful lucky is healing nicely thanks guys

I am beyond disgusted with ⁠BluePearl Pet Hospital. They are completely overpriced and exploit pet parents when they are vulnerable. I was hit with a massive bill just to sit and wait, and they didn’t even provide any real treatment or answers. It is horrible how they charge a fortune for literally nothing. Save your time, sanity, and money, and take your pet somewhere else.
Thank you for choosing us to care for your pet! It’s a privilege to be part of their journey, and we’re so grateful for your trust and positive review.

Everyone was exceptional professional especially the front desk personnel I had major issues putting through the amount patience of these people was way above & beyond the doctors night nurse I cannot say enough
Bellia had a great visit .
Came in for the first time with my puppy Zoro , incredible staff , amazing help . Helped me and Zoro . Grateful for the staff .

This is the worst veterinary clinic in the world. Their fees are chaotic and exorbitant, and many beloved pets have been forced to forgo treatment and lost their lives as a result. It's inhumane.

One-star review—this is the worst veterinary clinic. Their fees are chaotic and exorbitant, and many beloved pets have been forced to forgo treatment and lost their lives as a result.

I wish there was an option to select no stars or zero stars....I am writing to formally document an extremely disturbing and unprofessional experience I had with BluePearl Pet Hospital in Forest Hills. What occurred during my phone call with your male front‑desk attendant was not only unacceptable, but dangerous, dismissive, and a complete violation of basic veterinary‑care standards.

On the date of my call, I reached out because my cat was experiencing respiratory distress — a potentially life‑threatening medical issue. I calmly explained the symptoms and asked a simple, reasonable question:

“May I please speak to a veterinarian or doctor to determine whether I should bring my cat in immediately, or if there is anything I can try at home first?”

Instead of receiving compassion, guidance, or even basic professionalism, I was met with:

Rudeness

Dismissive behavior

A refusal to let me speak to a veterinarian

Incorrect statements about medical policy

Pressure to pay $250 before any doctor would even speak to me

The male attendant repeatedly emphasized — in a rude and condescending tone — that:

“You can’t speak to a doctor unless you pay $250 first. The doctor will tell you the same thing anyway.”

This statement was completely inappropriate, unprofessional, and medically irresponsible.
Receptionists are not veterinarians. They are not qualified to predict what a doctor will say, nor should they ever block a concerned pet owner from speaking to a medical professional — especially when the pet is having breathing issues.

His tone was cold, impatient, and dismissive, as if my cat’s health and my concerns were an inconvenience. At no point did he offer:

A callback from a doctor

A triage nurse

A message relay

Any empathy

Any urgency appropriate for a respiratory issue

Instead, he continued repeating the same line about the $250 fee, as though my cat’s life depended not on medical care, but on payment before communication.

This is not how an emergency veterinary hospital should operate.
This is not how frightened pet owners should be treated.
And this is not the standard of care BluePearl claims to uphold.

His behavior was so unprofessional that it raises serious concerns about:

Training and oversight

Customer service standards

Medical triage protocols

Whether staff understand the seriousness of respiratory symptoms in animals

No pet owner should ever be blocked from speaking to a veterinarian when their animal is in distress.
No receptionist should ever “speak for” a doctor.
And no one should be treated with such disrespect when seeking urgent help for a beloved pet.

I strongly urge management to review:

The call recordings

This employee’s conduct

Your hospital’s triage and communication procedures

This individual’s behavior was unacceptable and reflects extremely poorly on BluePearl as a whole.
Pet owners come to you in moments of fear and vulnerability. They deserve compassion, professionalism, and access to medical guidance — not rudeness, gatekeeping, and dismissive treatment.

I hope this complaint is taken seriously, and that corrective action is implemented immediately to prevent this from happening to anyone else. It's pretty obvious why they only have a 3.0 rating.

Sincerely,
A deeply concerned and disappointed pet owner
